text.p: The Singapore bunker 180-cst grade and 380-cst grade spread widened on Thursday amid continued tight supplies on the former, traders said.

Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $105-$106 per tonne and 380-cst at $98/$99. The spread was about $5/$6 on Wednesday. "Supplies on the 380-cst grade are all right but we are making a loss by offering $98 per tonne," said one trader, noting what he said were "artificial" cargo prices. The 380-cst grade cargo fuel oil was offered at $93.5 per tonne on Wednesday.
MDO and gas oil were quoted at $198/$200 and $212/$215 respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3571)
